title: Host's Mars UFO photo tweet turns out to be a rock

tellings.quote: I tweeted a thing. It was like, you know, this little um picture of like a UFO on Mars or whatever.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once posted a small picture online that seemed to show a UFO on Mars. As he tells it, the object turned out to be a rock. He shares it as an example of how easy it is to see something strange in a blurry photo.
